functions-for-signing-a-bundle.text: Names, argument names and result types only. No bodies.

bundle-module.text: encodeBundle(bundle): the JSON bytes of a bundle. Pure.

signing-module.text: detachedWitness(signKey, tx): the verification-key witness of the body hash of tx, signed by signKey.

sign-module.text: signBundle(bundlePath, vaultPath, passphraseSource, outputDirectory): reads, opens, checks, writes one witness file per transaction exclusively, prints the paths and the summary; refuses with a named refusal.

command-module.text: walletSignCommand(vaultPath, bundlePath, passphraseSource, outputDirectory): the parsed wallet sign command; refuses every registry and provider option by name.
